gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological verification of recurrent glioblastoma independent of methylated MGMT promotor status when alkylating chemotherapy failed at this time.

candidate_evidence.quote: In this trial, the drug is being tested outside of its actual approval as a radiosensitizer in combination with conventional radiotherapy for first-time recurrence (relapse) of malignant glioma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase I/II Dose Escalation Trial of Radiodynamic Therapy (RDT) With 5-Aminolevulinic Acid in Patients With First Recurrence of Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: concentration changes of CPI and CPIII: Analytic results for concentration changes as one combined sum parameter

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: concentration changes of immunhistochemistry marker (e.g. Caspase-3, IBA1, H&E, EvG, P53, Ki 67, gammaH2AX): analytic results of pharma-radio-dynamic tissue changes. Tissue samples collected during surgery of cohort 0 and 1

role_evidence.quote: A repetitive dose of Gliolan will be administrated in combination with radiotherapy (radiodynamic therapy)

agents.drug_class_hint: porphyrin precursor / photosensitiser prodrug (5-ALA, Gliolan), approved for fluorescence-guided glioma resection
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: radiosensitizer in combination with conventional radiotherapy (radiodynamic therapy)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Tissue IHC markers of treatment effect (Caspase-3, IBA1, P53, Ki 67, gammaH2AX)

source_quote.quote: concentration changes of immunhistochemistry marker (e.g. Caspase-3, IBA1, H&E, EvG, P53, Ki 67, gammaH2AX): analytic results of pharma-radio-dynamic tissue changes. Tissue samples collected during surgery of cohort 0 and 1

coder_notes: 5-ALA used therapeutically as a radiosensitiser activated by radiotherapy (radiodynamic therapy), so candidate with device_dependent true (C12; activation by radiation treated like PDT/SDT). Radiotherapy is the combination partner. CPI/CPIII (porphyrin) concentration changes may be PK/metabolite measures but the sample type is not stated, so tumour_pk_planned unclear. CD3/CD4/CD8/CD19/leucocyte 'radiobiological markers' appear to be immune-cell counts with unspecified sample and are not listed as tumour molecular biomarkers. MGMT is explicitly not a requirement.
